changelog: New voice command: say "previous" or "previous field" (in Bangla "প্রিভিয়াস" / "আগের ঘরে যাও") while dictating and the keyboard moves back to the previous field in a form — the pair of v13.8's "next field", handy when you overshoot a field while filling in a form. It only works where the form has a previous field; in WhatsApp it does nothing, and it never sends a message or deletes text.
